title: DRC-Clean Polysilicon-Metal Contact Cut
description: Caltech Intermediate Form (CIF 2.0) MOSIS SCMOS polysilicon-to-Metal-1 contact cell satisfying all lambda minimum-width design rules (>= 3 lambda).

title: Mead-Conway NMOS Inverter Layout
description: Classic Mead-Conway depletion-load NMOS inverter layout in CIF 2.0 featuring active diffusion, polysilicon pull-down gate, contact cuts, and Metal-1 VDD/GND power buses.

title: CMOS 2-Input NOR Standard Cell
description: Static CMOS 2-input NOR standard cell in CIF 2.0 with N-Well PMOS series pull-up stack, parallel NMOS pull-down diffusion, dual polysilicon gates, and Metal-1 routing.

title: 2-Phase Dynamic Shift Register Stage
description: Hierarchical CIF 2.0 2-phase non-overlapping clock dynamic shift register composing reusable inverter and pass-transistor subcells via C symbol calls and translations.

title: 4-Bit Carry-Lookahead Pad-Ring Macrocell
description: Multi-level CIF 2.0 ASIC macrocell integrating four mirrored carry-lookahead bit slices, Metal-1/Metal-2 carry-propagate buses, and perimeter I/O bonding pads using symbol calls and transforms.
